summary: On the main deck, Neo hangs plugged into a suspension chair while Tank, settling into his operator's chair, complains that loading all the operations programs first is boring and suggests starting with something more fun. Tank flips through a carousel of micro discs and proposes combat training. Neo reads the disc label and is surprised to find he is going to learn jujitsu. Tank slides the disc into Neo's supplement drive, Neo says 'No way,' and Tank punches the load code. Neo's body reacts violently as the program loads, and an instant later he exclaims 'Holy shit!' Tank notes that he likes it and asks if he is ready for more, to which Neo eagerly answers 'Hell yes!'

what_changes.before: An untrained mind about to begin with tedious operations programs
what_changes.after: Has jujitsu combat training loaded directly into his brain
what_changes.evidence: Tank slides the disk into Neo's supplement drive.

what_changes.before: Skeptical and resistant to the idea of learning jujitsu
what_changes.after: Thrilled by the experience and eager for more
what_changes.evidence: NEO: Holy shit! ... NEO: Hell yes!

event_hint.one_line: Tank loads a jujitsu combat program into Neo, who is amazed by it and wants more.
